bestNextCodexPrompt.block: W65: Approved Live Resolver Smoke And Drift Gate
bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W65: Approved Live Resolver Smoke And Drift Gate. Run the no-write websiteResolverServiceV1 path against an approved small set of live public websites, compare live resolver output to W58/W59 snapshot expectations, and produce a drift report with pass/fail, confidence calibration, failure-state honesty, evidence coverage, and any extraction gaps. Keep the drawer and SuiteScript write-disabled, preserve N/LLM advisory-only, keep notes story-only, and require blocked/thin/unavailable/timeout to remain insufficient evidence with no lane guesses. Output live smoke harness, approved-site results, drift findings, validator gates, W65 report, and best next Codex prompt.
